$comment: The one list of bot commands (architecture 3, section 6.10, ADR-052). Read by the Worker's registry (apps/bot/src/commands/registry.ts) and by scripts/set-webhook.mjs for Telegram's menu (setMyCommands). Every command is read-only. /start is an alias of /help and is not listed.
